title: Automated Inventory Reconciliation Loop
business: Logistics and warehouse management systems requiring real-time stock verification.
problem: Manual reconciliation of inventory discrepancies between digital records and physical warehouse scanners is slow and prone to human error.
solution: The Tool-Use Loop automates this by allowing the agent to iteratively query the database, trigger physical scanner APIs, and process results until the stock count matches or a final report is generated.
steps: Define an Agent with access to inventory database and scanner control tools.
Initialize a Runner to manage the execution lifecycle.
Invoke the Runner with the initial stock discrepancy report.
The Runner executes the loop: LLM decides on a tool, SDK executes the tool, and results are fed back to the LLM.
The loop terminates when the LLM produces a final text output confirming the reconciliation.
outcome: Reduced latency in inventory adjustments and higher accuracy in stock reporting without constant human intervention.
limitation: The loop may enter an infinite cycle if the LLM repeatedly calls the same tool with identical inputs; this is checked by monitoring the MaxTurnsExceeded exception.

code.content:
from agents import Agent, Runner
# Define agent with inventory tools
agent = Agent(name="InventoryAgent", tools=[query_db, trigger_scanner])
# Runner initiates the loop: LLM -> Tool -> LLM
result = await Runner.run(agent, "Reconcile SKU 12345")
# Final output is returned once the loop finishes
print(result.final_output)
code.explanation: This code demonstrates the Runner orchestrating the Tool-Use Loop where the agent iteratively uses tools to resolve a specific inventory task.
